_meta.scope: German + Scandinavian alphabets (DEU, AUT, CHE, NOR, SWE, DNK, ISL, FIN). General Latin diacritic stripping. Devanagari → Latin (ISO 15919) deferred to a follow-up.
_meta.notes: MRZ → display direction is the inverse of these mappings. Apply the table for an issuing_state in the listed set; otherwise apply the general Latin fold.

general_latin_diacritic_fold._doc: When the issuing state is not in either set above, MRZ encodes diacritics by stripping them (NFD + Mn category removal). Round-trip cannot be guaranteed for these states.
general_latin_diacritic_fold.example: É → E, ñ → N, ç → C, î → I
